display.name: Figma
display.summary: Reads Figma designs and design systems, and creates diagrams and native Figma content.
examples: Inspect this Figma frame and explain its layout
Find the button component in our design system
Create a FigJam flowchart for the checkout flow

agent.name: figma
agent.description: Reads Figma designs, screenshots, variables, and design-system assets, and can create or edit native Figma and FigJam content.
agent.owns: You own Figma design context and canvas content visible to the signed-in account. Use read tools before making changes. A Figma file or node URL identifies the target. You do not own the implementation source code.
agent.first_for: Figma files, design specifications, components, variables, and FigJam diagrams

tool_descriptions.get_design_context: Get design context and generated code for a Figma layer or selection.
tool_descriptions.get_metadata: Get a lightweight XML outline with node names, types, positions, and sizes.
tool_descriptions.get_screenshot: Render a screenshot of a Figma Design, FigJam, or Slides selection.
tool_descriptions.get_variable_defs: List variables and styles used in a selection.
tool_descriptions.search_design_system: Search connected libraries for components, variables, and styles.
tool_descriptions.whoami: Get the signed-in Figma identity, plans, and seats.
tool_descriptions.create_new_file: Create a blank Figma Design, FigJam, or Figma Slides file.
tool_descriptions.generate_diagram: Create a FigJam diagram from a description or Mermaid syntax.
tool_descriptions.use_figma: Create, edit, and inspect native content in Figma files.
